n-Dimensional  Variational Problems

We now give several examples of higher-dimensional variational problems
        that use the theory developed in previous chapters. The basic notation is
        provided by the Sobolev spaces developed in Chapter 1. We combine the
        existence theory of Chapter 2 together with the approximation theory of
        Chapters 3 and 4 to provide a complete theory for the discretization process.
        Several examples will be fully developed in the text, and several others are
        found in the exercises. Throughout this chapter, we assume that the domain
        Ω is bounded.
